status: G5 first batch: processed, compressed and reviewed; ships as g5-debris-east, in Chapters V, VI and IX (on the web in Chapters V and VI only)
use: The field after a victory: what a beaten eastern force leaves beside its fallen, on the walked field.

generator.prompt: Battlefield debris of a beaten Persian or Palmyrene force lying flat on the ground: two large oval shields of woven wicker covered with painted hide, a broken lance, a dropped quiver of arrows and a curved composite bow, scattered over about two metres; nothing stands more than twenty centimetres high. Painted hide, wicker, wood and leather. Single isolated static prop for a grounded painterly-realistic historical game set in the third century Roman world. Physically based aged materials, believable hand-made construction and a bold, solid, readable silhouette from above, restrained surface detail, level base and complete geometry from every side. No environment, ground plane, decorative display plinth, modern materials, text, logos or people.

budget.note: Height set at review from 0.22 m: its weapons lie across its shields, so 0.36 m keeps the shields about a metre long and its spread about 1.9 m. Bytes raised at review from 220,000 for its texture.
